comparison.objective: Mount a shaft between fixed and sprung bench centres; candidate mounts a rack rail between rack posts.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a lever, seat one shaft end, align the axis, and ease a sprung centre in versus support and regrasp a long rail, depress a tab, latch paired prongs, telescope, and fasten.
comparison.success_condition: Both shaft points seated with lever restored and shaft stable versus four spring prongs engaged at matching rack units plus prescribed screws and self-support.
comparison.reason: This is the closest long-part alignment record, but it tests coaxial seating under one sprung centre rather than sequential load-bearing latching at four holes and screw securing.
